response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong technical expertise and diverse experience in software development, including leadership in open-source projects and mentorship. While his background aligns well with the technical and architectural requirements of the role, his German language proficiency is below the required C1 level, and his leadership experience is more hands-on than executive-level. His fit for the role is promising but not definitive without further assessment.
strengths: Extensive experience in full-stack development and open-source technologies, including Linux/Unix environments.
Proven track record in architectural design, system optimization, and technical mentorship across multiple industries.
Strong alignment with the role's emphasis on open-source, digital sovereignty, and interdisciplinary collaboration.
concerns: German language proficiency is listed as 'Basic,' falling short of the required C1 level.
Leadership experience is primarily technical and hands-on; lacks explicit executive-level or operational leadership in client-facing projects.
While experienced in team collaboration, there is limited evidence of strategic advisory or high-level client engagement in IT architecture and security.
